content.user_title: Prepare Your Flemish SME Subsidy Application
content.value_statement: Flemish SMEs must coordinate subsidy eligibility, application details, payments, and supporting evidence. This skill guides preparation of kmo-portefeuille working documents for review against current VLAIO requirements.
actual_capabilities: Guide checks of enterprise and service provider eligibility for kmo-portefeuille support.
Structure an application draft with a project description, service period, and advice or training classification.
Explain subsidy calculations using enterprise size and verified support percentages and ceilings.
Outline the payment sequence from the enterprise contribution to subsidy allocation and portal invoicing.
Prepare a supporting evidence checklist for a possible VLAIO review.
Guide service providers in preparing for a registration quality audit.
limitations: Guidance applies only to the Flemish kmo-portefeuille scheme.
Support rates, ceilings, deadlines, eligible services, and provider recognition require verification against current VLAIO information.
Outputs are working documents, not approved applications or guarantees of funding.
This folder contains only the public guide, without scripts, extension source, or original package templates.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first subsidy request
use_cases.description: Identify eligibility questions, application details, and payment steps before preparing a first kmo-portefeuille application.

use_cases.title: Guide client preparation
use_cases.description: Organize client project details and provider eligibility checks for a training or advice engagement.

use_cases.title: Prepare supporting evidence
use_cases.description: Build an evidence checklist and identify missing records before a possible VLAIO review.

prompt_templates.title: Start an eligibility check
prompt_templates.prompt: I run a Flemish SME and plan to purchase [service]. List the enterprise and provider details needed to assess kmo-portefeuille eligibility. Identify rules requiring current VLAIO verification.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: collect the information needed before assessing eligibility.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an application outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a kmo-portefeuille application outline for [project], delivered by [provider] between [dates]. Include the project description, proposed advice or training classification, missing details, and eligibility questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn known project details into a reviewable draft.

prompt_templates.title: Plan subsidy and payment steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these verified VLAIO rules, [rules], and my project details, [details], estimate support and my contribution. Show assumptions, applicable ceilings, payment steps, and deadlines requiring confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: connect verified funding rules to project costs and payment planning.

prompt_templates.title: Review a complete dossier
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this redacted kmo-portefeuille dossier: [details]. Check consistency across enterprise size, provider eligibility, service category, dates, costs, payments, and evidence. Use these verified rules: [rules]. Separate missing evidence from unresolved eligibility questions and prioritize corrective actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review application consistency and prepare for a possible evidence check.

output_examples.input: I plan to book a training course for my Flemish SME. What should I prepare before applying?
output: Enterprise details: confirm enterprise size and the information needed for eligibility review.
Provider check: verify current recognition for the planned service.
Project draft: collect the training description, service dates, and eligible cost information.
Rule check: confirm current support rates, ceilings, and application deadlines with VLAIO.
Evidence file: organize project, invoice, and payment records for review.

output_examples.input: Assume eligibility is verified, eligible costs are EUR 1,000, and the verified support rate is 30%, with no binding ceiling.
output: Illustrative enterprise contribution toward eligible costs: EUR 700.
This estimate depends on the supplied assumptions and is not a funding approval.
Payment plan: confirm portal instructions and deadlines before paying the enterprise contribution.

best_practices: Verify current VLAIO rules and provider recognition before relying on an eligibility assessment or calculation.
Provide enterprise size, service type, dates, and eligible costs before requesting an application draft.
Keep project, invoice, and payment records together, and redact sensitive information before sharing documents.
anti_patterns: Treating the guide's example percentages or deadlines as permanently valid rules.
Assuming a generated draft is an approved application or proof of eligibility.
Expecting the public guide to submit applications or execute portal payments automatically.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It supports Flemish SMEs, service providers, and administrators preparing kmo-portefeuille working documents.

faq.question: Does it submit applications or make payments?
faq.answer: The public guide describes preparation and payment steps. It includes no submission or payment automation.

faq.question: Are its subsidy rates and deadlines guaranteed to be current?
faq.answer: No. Verify support rates, ceilings, deadlines, eligible services, and provider recognition with VLAIO at the time of application.

faq.question: Can it help with service provider registration?
faq.answer: The guide covers preparation for a provider registration quality audit. It does not grant registration or replace the official process.

faq.question: What files are included?
faq.answer: The package contains one SKILL.md public guide. Original scripts, extension source, and templates are not included.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee subsidy approval?
faq.answer: No. Its outputs are working documents that require review against current requirements and the official application process.
